name: Onee-san x Scratch
source:
This is a spin-off item, focusing on onesan. Three onesan take care of you sweetly, but sometimes severely.... Full of onesan H!!! Just enjoy lovelove H life with three onesan!

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
这是一部以大姐姐为焦点的衍生作品。三位大姐姐会温柔地照顾你，偶尔也会十分严厉…满载大姐姐H内容！尽情享受与三位大姐姐甜甜蜜蜜的H生活吧！

[From ErogeShop]
